verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented, downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec for Stripe Financial Connections, and the probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.stripe.com. The llms.txt file, the markdown docs, the MCP server and the CLI are related AI-friendly resources, but none of them is a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
